{{alias}}( order, M, N, KL, KU, AB, LDAB, PIV )
    Computes an unblocked LU factorization of a real general band matrix.

    H=2KL+KU+1 and KV=KL+KU. The full compact AB view is H-by-N;
    dense input A(i,j) occupies band row KV+i-j. Top KL rows reserve
    fill capacity, not original matrix input. Source-defined unused
    slots and guards remain unchanged. KL/KU may exceed dimensions.

    Returns numeric INFO and writes min(M,N) positive 1-based stepwise
    row-swap outputs. Repeated pivots are valid, not a final permutation.
    Positive INFO is the first exactly-zero U pivot; later steps continue.
    INFO=0 is not a stability certificate. Finite active inputs and
    finite intermediate arithmetic define reference-comparison scope;
    the original tiny-pivot reciprocal may overflow.

    Active arrays require intrinsic ordinary ArrayBuffer backing,
    including currently valid resizable backing. SharedArrayBuffer
    views are rejected. Stable exclusive backing is required throughout
    the synchronous call: no resize, detach, transfer or foreign mutation.
    Shadow properties do not change intrinsic metadata. Full AB must
    fit and be injective; AB/PIV indexed-byte envelopes are disjoint.
    Distinct foreign ordinary buffers sharing physical storage are
    outside the pure JavaScript caller contract.

    Validate layout, M/N/KL/KU, exact H/KV and LDAB before empty return.
    For M=0 or N=0, return zero without accessing arrays/unused ndarray
    metadata, native dispatch, allocations or writes. Column-major
    LDAB>=H and row-major LDAB>=max(1,N) still apply. Raw native/C use
    their configured integer domain; valid wide public empty scalars
    are not narrowed into a native call.

    TypeError rejects invalid selectors, active brands and backing;
    RangeError rejects geometry/integer/arithmetic errors before writes.
    Native allocation failure throws Error. Native eligibility is checked
    before writes; unused singleton strides may be normalized to one.
    Output-only native pivots are staged before writes across widths.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string|number
        Row-major (101) or column-major (102) compact-band layout.

    M: integer
        Nonnegative safe row count, at most 2147483647.

    N: integer
        Nonnegative safe column count, at most 2147483647.

    KL: integer
        Nonnegative safe lower bandwidth, at most 2147483647.

    KU: integer
        Nonnegative safe upper bandwidth, at most 2147483647.

    AB: Float64Array
        Full input/output H-by-N compact band view.

    LDAB: integer
        At least H column-major or max(1,N) row-major, including empty.

    PIV: Int32Array
        Positive min(M,N) 1-based stepwise pivot outputs.

    Returns
    -------
    info: number
        Zero or the first exactly-zero U pivot position.

    Examples
    --------
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0, 2, 0 ] );
    > var P = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/int32}}( 3 );
    > {{alias}}( 'row-major', 3, 3, 0, 0, A, 3, P )
    1
    > P
    <Int32Array>[ 1, 2, 3 ]
    > A
    <Float64Array>[ 0, 2, 0 ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( M, N, KL, KU, AB, r, c, oa, PIV, sp, op )
    Factors using explicit element strides/offsets relative to each view.

    AB[oa+b*r+j*c] contains band row b/column j; PIV[op+i*sp] receives
    step i. Signed independent strides are supported; mutable broadcasts
    with extent greater than one and colliding band cells are rejected.
    For an empty matrix, validate M/N/KL/KU and H/KV, then return zero
    without array or unused metadata access, native dispatch or writes.
    All active backing/envelope/finite-domain rules above apply.

    Parameters
    ----------
    M: integer
        Nonnegative safe row count, at most 2147483647.

    N: integer
        Nonnegative safe column count, at most 2147483647.

    KL: integer
        Nonnegative safe lower bandwidth, at most 2147483647.

    KU: integer
        Nonnegative safe upper bandwidth, at most 2147483647.

    AB: Float64Array
        Full input/output H-by-N compact band view.

    r: integer
        Band-row element stride.

    c: integer
        Matrix-column element stride.

    oa: integer
        Band starting index.

    PIV: Int32Array
        Positive min(M,N) 1-based stepwise pivot outputs.

    sp: integer
        Pivot element stride.

    op: integer
        Pivot starting index.

    Returns
    -------
    info: number
        Zero or the first exactly-zero U pivot position.

    Examples
    --------
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 9, 0, 2, 0, 9 ] );
    > var P = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/int32}}( [ 8, -99, -99, -99, 8 ] );
    > {{alias}}.ndarray( 3, 3, 0, 0, A, 1, -1, 3, P, -1, 3 )
    1
    > P
    <Int32Array>[ 8, 3, 2, 1, 8 ]
    > A
    <Float64Array>[ 9, 0, 2, 0, 9 ]

    See Also
    --------
